decisive_items: 1.9 cm × 2.8 cm contrast-enhancing mass in bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy
isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
response.rationale: The presence of a contrast-enhancing mass in the bladder wall and the patient's symptoms are more consistent with paraganglioma, particularly an extra-adrenal location, than pheochromocytoma, despite both having similar biochemical signatures.

rejected.why: Normal adrenal glands on CT and the specific location of the mass in the bladder wall make pheochromocytoma less likely.
